text:
Rina: hey all, day 1! quick logistics Qs: where do I file VPN issues vs badge/hardware? also, where's the 'how to quiet bots' guide?
Marco: welcome Rina :tada: VPN and devbox access issues -> #eng-infra. badge/hardware -> #people-ops (equipment form). bot noise -> #devex has a pinned "bot controls" doc.
Rina: thanks. any shortcut commands to request a devbox?
Marco: yep, in any channel `@infra-bot request devbox --type=linux --gpu=none` or use the infra shortcut in the channel composer.
SRE-bot: Reminder: do not mute #eng-oncall or #incidents. Alerts in those channels are escalated automatically.
Rina: noted. how should I post my intro? short bio in #new-hires or post both there and my team channel?
Marco: post in #new-hires for onboarding folks, then a 1-line in your team channel. Intro template pinned in #new-hires: "Name | Pronouns | Team | Timezone | 1-line focus | fun fact"
people-ops: Badge requests processed in 48-72 hrs. If you need same-day access, select "expedite" on the form and cc people-ops.
Rina: perfect. last question: if a deploy bot posts large logs, should I paste logs or link to a gist?
Marco: always link to a gist or internal drive. paste only small snippets inline. use triple backticks for config/code in threads: ```export AWS_REGION=us-west-2```
infra-bot: License request received for Rina: JetBrains Ultimate. Ticket #9122.
Rina: great, thanks everyone — this is super helpful :thumbsup:
